verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Copilot can "automatically select the best model for each task" (docs-17). This is backed by documentation of a multi-model lineup with different speed, cost and accuracy tradeoffs (docs-7, docs-30), so the core of the story is claimed directly. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how auto-selection works (criteria, which surfaces or plans support it, effect on premium-request limits), independent or hands-on corroboration that auto model selection works as described.
